summary.text: John Kane was elected in 2022 to represent House District 11 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives. He is a multi-generational cattle rancher and business owner from Bartlesville.

paragraphs.text: Kane was born and raised in Bartlesville and attended the University of Kansas, then earned a certificate from Texas Christian University's School of Ranch Management.
After beginning a career in banking, he moved home to join his family's cattle-ranching operation with his father, which he now operates with his son.
In April 2021 Governor Stitt appointed Kane to the Oklahoma Tourism and Recreation Commission; he resigned in late 2021 to run for his current seat.
He and his wife, Barbara, have five children and eight grandchildren.
